SELECT

  SUM(new_users) AS new_users
FROM growth_daily_metrics
WHERE metric_date >= '2026-01-01' AND metric_date < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY STRFTIME(metric_date, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month ASC

execution_log.label: 转化事件数
execution_log.description: 按渠道产生的转化事件总数量从高到低排序
execution_log.question: 请问“表现最好”具体是指哪个指标最高？

arguments.sql:
SELECT
  ac.channel_name,
  COUNT(*) AS conversion_event_count
FROM short_video_ops.channel_conversion_events cce
JOIN short_video_ops.acquisition_channels ac ON cce.channel_id = ac.channel_id
WHERE cce.converted_at >= '2026-05-01' AND cce.converted_at < '2026-06-01'
GROUP BY ac.channel_name
ORDER BY conversion_event_count DESC, ac.channel_name ASC
